Subject: Request: supplemental sandbox funds for nightshift validation

Hi Neha,

Thanks for the quick intro earlier. We have a 12-hour overnight soak planned for Thursday (start 00:00 UTC) to validate end-to-end latency and 99th percentile behavior under sustained 1k qps with mixed short/long sequences. Our internal SREs ran a smaller warmup but we need additional sandbox quota to run the full profile.

Ask: can Redwood provision an extra 50k token-equivalent allowance (or a temporary increase in concurrent endpoint quota) for our account for a single 12-hour window? We expect ~45k tokens consumed but asking for 50k to be safe.

Attached: Datasprint_PoC_RunPlan_20270530.pdf (plan + telemetry points) and load_profile_nightshift_v2.json (load generator profile).

Acceptance criteria:
- Run completes without 503s;
- p95 < 350ms, p99 < 700ms;
- We can collect full traces/latency histograms.

Decision timeline: we need confirmation by Monday 10:00 PDT to lock automation and deploy scripts.

Appreciate the help — happy to hop on a 15-min sync if needed.

Best,
Alex Rivera
Director of SRE, Datasprint AI

ops@datasprint.ai

- Can you confirm the exact start/end timestamps in UTC for the 12-hour window? (you listed "Thursday" — we want to schedule the uplift precisely).
- Do you need an isolated Dedicated slot or is a sandbox top-up on the hosted endpoint sufficient?
- Will you enable debug-level traces for the entire run or sample traces? Full traces will increase storage costs if we need to preserve them.

As a provisional offering we can issue a promotional +25k token allowance to the account immediately while I route manager approval for the additional headroom you requested. That provisional top-up would be applied as a temporary allowance tied to the DS-2027-089 deal and will expire 48 hours after the run.

If you can confirm the exact window and isolation requirement by EOD PDT today I will start the approval thread. Also adding Ben from our sales ops to help on billing and tracking.

Thanks,
